summary_text: On 2026-05-04 (weekday), one order of Nestlé Cerelac Wheat Apple Carrot Cereal (300 g) was placed in the afternoon. The product is a complementary infant cereal, typically used for feeding infants aged 6–24 months. This is a single observation on one date.
